paragraphs: R' Shimon bar Abba interpreted it before R' Yohanan: end of Bekhorot. R' Yohanan said, “Whoever does not know Avraham's deeds should recognize this man's forebears' deeds”: Jerusalem Talmud, end of Bikkurim. He was expert in pearls but had nothing to eat: Midrash Kohelet, at “Nor bread to the wise.” There, R' Yohanan would scatter sela coins so that R' Shimon bar Abba might acquire them. In Jerusalem Bava Metzia, Ellu Metzi'ot, halakhah 3: R' Shimon bar Abba was walking behind R' Elazar, who dropped a dinar intending that R' Shimon bar Abba, who was poor, might acquire it. R' Avahu said in R' Yohanan's name that one may teach one's daughter Greek. R' Shimon bar Abba said that R' Yohanan had not said this; see his entry. Ilufosa gave R' Shimon bar Abba tithes. R' Elazar went to visit him. He asked R' Elazar whether, because he was weak, he fulfilled his obligation when reciting the Shema while dozing. He answered, “Yes.” R' Yirmeyah asked R' Zeira whether R' Elazar ruled thus because he knew that R' Shimon bar Abba was meticulous in commandments, or …: Jerusalem Berakhot, beginning of chapter 2. R' Helbo; R' Shimon bar Abba in R' Yohanan's name: Shevuot, beginning of chapter 6. He said in R' Hanina's name: Shabbat 119b; Jerusalem Megillah 4:4. He brought a bill of divorce before R' Yehoshua ben Levi: Gittin 5b. He attended R' Yohanan and handed him his sandals: Jerusalem Ba-Meh Ishah, halakhah 2. In R' Yohanan's name: Jerusalem Mo'ed Katan 1:7; beginning of Megillah; end of Sotah chapter 6; Metzi'at ha-Ishah, halakhah 3; Berakhot, chapter 3 end of mishnah 5, chapter 4 end of mishnah 3, chapter 5 mishnah 2; Bereshit Rabbah chapter 42; Yelammedenu, Shemini. In R' Yonatan's name. And R' Yaakov bar Aha. R' Yaakov bar Zavdi rose before him. R' Simon reports in his name: Midrash Eikhah, at “From the daughter of Zion went out.” His son Rav Amram reports in his name. Resh Lakish reports in his name: Temurah 12, end of side b. In R' Shimon's name: Bemidbar Rabbah, section 15.
